title: EDAGoat: An EDA-Aware Agent for Project-Level GPU Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GPU acceleration has transformed electronic design automation (EDA), yet further improving expert-engineered GPU tools still demands substantial manual effort. Automating this work calls for coding agents that can trace bottlenecks across host and device code while preserving correctness and design quality. We introduce EDAGoat, to our knowledge the first EDA-aware GPU optimization agent for this task. Its optimization enhancement (OE) mode guides edits with four cross-project GPU optimization patterns. Its mandatory validation (MV) mode requires the agent to test the edited program against the EDA constraints its changes could affect. Our benchmark covers five GPU EDA projects across four task families and 55 circuit inputs, measuring complete-solve runtime and verifying the resulting designs. Each configuration runs three independent searches per project. A search qualifies only if its solver passes correctness and design-quality check

translated_title: EDAGoat：一个面向项目级GPU优化的EDA感知智能体
translated_abstract: GPU加速已经变革了电子设计自动化（EDA）领域，然而要进一步改进专家手工构建的GPU工具仍需要大量的人工投入。实现这项工作的自动化，需要能够跨主机端与设备端代码追踪性能瓶颈、同时保持正确性和设计质量的编码智能体。我们提出了EDAGoat，据我们所知，这是首个面向该任务的EDA感知GPU优化智能体。其优化增强（OE）模式利用四种跨项目的GPU优化模式来指导代码编辑。其强制验证（MV）模式要求智能体针对其修改可能影响的EDA约束对编辑后的程序进行测试。我们的基准测试涵盖五个GPU EDA项目、四个任务族和55个电路输入，测量完整求解运行时间并验证生成的设计。每种配置在每个项目上运行三次独立搜索。只有当求解器通过正确性和设计质量检查时，该次搜索才被认定为合格。
tldr: 提出了首个EDA感知的GPU优化智能体EDAGoat，通过四种跨项目GPU优化模式指导代码编辑、并以强制验证模式确保修改满足EDA正确性与设计质量约束，实现了项目级GPU EDA工具优化的自动化。
en_tdlr: EDAGoat, the first EDA-aware GPU optimization agent, automates project-level GPU optimization for EDA tools by guiding edits with cross-project optimization patterns and mandating validation against EDA correctness and design-quality constraints.
